questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

How did they become (1)/ the most successful investors (2)/ America have ever seen? (3)/ No error (4).
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, concept of past tense is brought under consideration. Since, the starter of the sentence has verb **did **of past tense. Thus, same pattern to be followed in whole sentence. So, replace **have **with **had. **Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **How did they become the most successful investors America had ever seen?

questions.question:
**In the following question, some part of the sentence may have errors. Find out which part of the sentence has an error and select the appropriate option. If a sentence is free from error, select 'No Error'.**

He found comfort in fantasy and (1)/ science-ﬁction books which inspiring (2)/ him to leave a legacy in the world. (3)/ No error (4)
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of past tense is brought under consideration. Since, the starter of the sentence has verb of simple past tense i.e. **found. **Hence, same pattern should be followed in the complete sentence. So, replace **inspiring **with **inspired. **Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **He found comfort in fantasy and science-ﬁction books which inspired him to leave a legacy in the world.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

Nobody will help you but ______.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of subject pronoun is brought under consideration. Since, conjunction is used between same type of speech. Pronoun **you **is used as both subject pronoun or object pronoun. Firstly, pronouns** my & mine **are possessive pronouns. Thus, options 1 & 3 are eliminated. Again, **their **is a possessive pronoun. Hence, option 4 is eliminated. So, option 2 i.e. **I **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **Nobody will help you but I.

questions.question:
**In the following question, the sentence given with blank to be ﬁlled in with an appropriate word. Select the correct alternative out of the four and indicate it by selecting the appropriate option.**

One must not praise ______ self.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Here, topic of objective pronoun(reflexive pronoun) is brought under consideration. Since, object pronoun is used according to the subject pronoun. Here, subject pronoun is **one, **then object pronoun which should be used is **oneself. **Hence, option 4 i.e. **one **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **One must not praise oneself.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

FORBID
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given word 'forbid' :- To command a person or animal not to do a particular thing; to prohibit; to prevent; to exclude.

Now, we check the meaning of given options :-

Include - To contain; intake.

Standout - Someone or something, as a person, performance, etc., that is far better than others.

Preclude - To prevent the presence, existence, or occurrence of; make impossible.

Welcome - A kindly greeting or reception.

Clearly, the word **preclude **best expresses the meaning of 'forbid'. Hence, option 3 i.e. **preclude **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

HAGGARD
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given word 'haggard' :- A person having an exhausted appearance, as from a very long suffering; exertion; anxiety.

Now, get to the meaning of given options :-

Hardworking - An industrious person; laborious.

Plump - Well filled out or rounded in form.

Healthy - A person having good health; fit.

Exhausted - A person who is very tired; lethargic.

Thus, the word **exhausted**** **best expresses the meaning of given word 'haggard'. So, option 4 i.e. **exhausted **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which best expresses the meaning of the given word.**

INSIPID
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given word 'insipid' :- Someone or something that is not interesting; without sufficient taste to be pleasing.

Now, check the meaning of given options :-

Innocuous - Not interesting; not harmful; pallid; pale.

Original - New; fresh; inventive.

Exciting - Thrilling; interesting.

Jovial - Joyous; humorous; happy; exciting.

Clearly, the word **innocuous **best expresses the meaning of given word 'insipid'. Hence, option 1 i.e. **innocuous **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in meaning of the given word.**

LUSTER
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of 'luster' :- The quality of shining by reflecting light, glitter, sparkle, sheen, gloss, dazzle.

Whereas, meaning of matte is having a dull or lusterless surface.

Thus, word **matte **is the most opposite in meaning of the given word 'luster'. So, option 3 i.e. **matte **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in meaning of the given word.**

VICTOR
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of 'victor' :- A person who has overcome or defeated the opponent; a winner; king; hero; champ.

Whereas, 

Loser - A person, team or nation that loses the game or war; who are defeated.

Clearly, word **loser **is the most opposite in meaning of the given word 'victor'. Thus, option 4 i.e. **victor **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the one which is opposite in meaning of the given word.**

DARKEN
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of 'darken' :- To make something dark or darker; to make less clear in colour; gloomy; deepen; dim.

Now, find out the meaning of other given options :-

Eclipse - It is the act of darkening the light of the moon by the interference of the earth between it and the sun. 

Illuminated - To supply or brighten up with light; glow up.

Clearly, word **illuminated **is the most opposite in meaning of the given word 'darken'. Thus, option 4 i.e. **illuminated **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Be under somebody’s thumb

options.text: To be about from duty without permission
To destroy in the very beginning

questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

The correct meaning of above mentioned passage is when someone or something is completely under someone's else influence or control. Thus, option 2 is the most appropriate answer.

**For example - **He was very much under the thumb of his father.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.**

Get wind of something
questions.solution:
**Correct option 2**

The correct meaning of above mentioned passage is to learn a piece of information, esp. when it has been a secret; to find about something. Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.

**For example - ** I don't want my colleagues to get wind of the fact that I'm leaving.

questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.**

The consequences of her removal (inside the) meeting of the general counsel of the party will be immediate.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Here, topic of preposition is brought under consideration. Meeting is an act of coming together, assembling to discuss things or make decisions. It is not a place, or thing, etc. which can be used to go inside it. Hence, option 4 is eliminated. Now, decisions are taken while the meeting is going on, but not before or after it. Hence, option 2 is eliminated. If we use preposition **on **then we need to define a certain day or place. For example - On Friday meeting. So, option 1 is eliminated. Whereas, **at the **will be directly related with **meeting. **Hence, option 3 i.e. **at the **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **The consequences of her removal at the meeting of the general counsel of the party will be immediate.

questions.question:
**Improve the bracketed part of the sentence.**

While there are (much) in the party, including ministers, who still sympathize with her.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Here, concept of adjectives is brought under consideration. Let's find out the uses of given options :-

Many - A large number usually countable.

Most - In the majority; greatest, as in size or extent.

Less - To a smaller extent, amount, or degree.

Much - Great in quant

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase.**

A fear of closed places.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given options :-

Homophobia - Unreasoning fear of homosexuals.

Claustrophobia - Fear of being in enclosed or narrow places.

Aerophobia - An abnormal fear of drafts of air, gases, or airborne matter.

Monophobia - An abnormal fear of being alone.

Clearly, option 2 i.e. **claustrophobia **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
**In the following question, out of the four given alternatives, select the alternative which is the best substitute of the phrase.**

A list of things to be discussed at a meeting.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Let's find out the meaning of given options :-

Meeting - An assembly or conference of persons for a specific purpose.

Notice - An note; information of warning of something.

Notion - A general understanding; an opinion, view or belief.

Agenda - A list, plan, outline of things to be done, matters to be acted or voted upon, etc.

Clearly, option 4 i.e. **agenda **is the correct answer.

questions.question: **In the following question, a word has been written in four different ways out of which only one is correctly spelt. Select the correctly spelt word.**
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

The correct spelling is **guidance. **It means the act of guiding or leading a person, group, etc.

**For example - **It is an opportunity for young people to improve their performance under the guidance of professional coaches.

questions.question: **In the following question, a word has been written in four different ways out of which only one is correctly spelt. Select the correctly spelt word.**
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

The correct spelling is **encyclopedia. **It means a book, set of books, optical disc, or online resource that contains articles on various topics, usually in alphabetical order and it covers all branches of knowledge.

**For example - **He had gifted me an encyclopedia by Diderot and D'Alembert on my birthday.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

There was a

P: the river, from one

Q: thick rope tied across

R: bank to the another
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Clearly, a sentence does not end with a preposition. Hence, option 3 is eliminated. Now, the starter ends with an article **a**, thus it cannot follow another article **the. **Thus, option 1 is eliminated. There are certain prepositions which are used in pair such as from....to, it shows time or place from start to end. Hence, it should be in correct order of **from...to**. Thus, option 2 is eliminated. Hence, option 4 i.e. **QPR **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **There was a thick rope tied across the river, from one bank to the another.

questions.question:
**Rearrange the parts of the sentence in correct order.**

I knew that

P: challenge with courage 

Q: result of facing a

R: this conﬁdence was a
questions.solution:
**Correct option -4**

Clearly, the sentence cannot end with an article **a. **Hence, options 1, 2 & 3 are clearly eliminated. So, option 4 i.e. **RQP **is the correct answer.

**Correct sentence - **I knew that this conﬁdence was a result of facing a challenge with courage .

questions.question: the fact of ______ in diversity.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 1**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of given options :-

Unity - The state of being one; together; oneness.

Adversity - Situations which are not in favor or useful to a person.

Relativity - The state of being connected with other person or thing.

Creativity - Having to transform traditional ideas, rules, patterns, etc.

Clearly, options 2, 3 & 4 are out of context. Because India has always set an example of country with unity in diversity. So, option 1 i.e. **unity **is the correct answer.

questions.question: for many years without ______ problem
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 2**

Here, concept of adjective is brought under consideration. Since, word **without **is a preposition used to define absence, omission or avoidance of something. Also, adjective **any **is used to define without. That is having nothing. So, option 2 i.e. **any **is the correct answer. That is, people of various religions and castes have managed to live together for many years without any problem.

questions.question: ancient culture and ______,
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 3**

Firstly, let's find out the meaning of the given options :-

Festival - A day or time of religious or other celebrations.

Rites - A formal or ceremonial act or procedure prescribed in a religion.

Tradition - Continuing the legacy of beliefs, customs, information, etc., from one generation to another generation.

Themes - A subject of discussion; topic; etc.

With reference to the context, word **culture **is mainly connected with tradition. Because, culture means the behaviours and beliefs characteristic of a particular social, ethnic, or age group, etc. So, option 3 i.e. **tradition **is the correct answer. That is, India is decorated by the high mountains, valleys, oceans, famous rivers, streams, forests, deserts, ancient culture and tradition.

questions.question: all have ______ characteristic
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

With reference to the context of the sentence, in India, people of different race, religion and language have the same feature of humanity & kindness. Words **dislike & unlike **gives contradiction to the context. And, **nominal **means so-called; in name only. But, humanity is not that is done for namesake. Hence, options 1, 2 & 3 are eliminated. Thus, option 4 i.e. **similar **is the correct answer. That is, People here belong to their own race, religion and language however they all have similar characteristic of humanity which make them able to live together.

questions.question: able to ______ together.
questions.solution:
**Correct option - 4**

Clearly, the whole passage is based on different types of people living together happily. Hence, option 4 i.e. **live **is the correct answer. That is, People here belong to their own race, religion and language however they all have similar characteristic of humanity which make them able to live together.
